criterion.interval: Criterion median point estimate and its 95% confidence interval

correctness_guard.pre_timing_exact_metrics_assertion: Criterion harness assert_eq passed at 1k/8k/64k observations for legacy two-pass, tuple API, and fused column API, including all cumulative, period, and risk metric fields
correctness_guard.source_contract: The core reducer validates alignment and positive prices while calculating period active returns and Welford risk metrics in one pass; app report analysis consumes BarFrame columns directly

interpretation: The isolated fused-column path is 7.07% faster at 1k, within noise at 8k (-0.56%), and 5.77% faster at 64k versus the prior two-pass reducer with a prebuilt tuple Vec. Confidence intervals overlap at each size; this is suggestive rather than statistically conclusive. The 64k path avoids 1,024,000 bytes of tuple payload (excluding Vec metadata/capacity). The synthetic microbenchmark excludes file loading, report serialization, and full A-share replay and does not imply end-to-end speedup.
